one_liner: Loud, punk-styled dirt sprinter-miler in a rebellious phase who hides a devoted, home-cooking family girl under constant bluster.
personality: A self-described 'yapping rebellious-phase girl' (profile tagline) who barks threats, insults and 'Oraa!' at everyone, especially her trainer, and insists she is the strongest. Under the act she is plainly kind and domestic: she cooks osechi with her mother, makes chocolate for her family every year, brings the trainer a birthday bento, and helps slow friends carry luggage, then furiously denies any of it is nice. She constantly overcompensates when caught being sleepy, scared or nervous ('I'm not scared!'), and quietly asks the trainer to tell her she'll be okay before races.

story_arc.summary: A defiant girl who distrusts adults and leadership takes on a trainer and the dirt circuit, aiming at the Mile CS Nanbu Hai, Champions Cup, February Stakes, Kashiwa Kinen, Teio Sho and JBC Sprint. Event titles ('Lump of Defiance', 'Writing Hope in the Textbook', 'Call with Mother', 'Hope Shines with Pride') trace her bluster softening into trust. Per the wiki, her mother is in hospital and she races for her, and after the Teio Sho her trainer is badly hurt in a car accident; 'Espoir' (hope) is the recurring theme.
